Internal review only · open capability placeholders
Not public packaging or pricing

LITE, BASE and PRO are provisional experiment labels. Rates, entitlements, availability and customer-facing claims remain gated pending measured provider/API costs, AI usage, support effort, pilot evidence and finance/legal review.

Internal experiment label

LITE

Information/menu/basic WhatsApp workflow with advisory AI.

Boundary placeholder. No advanced API integration; usage allowance and rate remain internal planning placeholders.

Internal experiment label

BASE

Pickup/order workflow with human takeover, standard operational integrations and advisory AI.

Boundary placeholder. Order and payment state stays deterministic and reviewable; usage allowance and rate remain internal planning placeholders.

Internal experiment label

PRO

Advanced API integrations, richer automation and a higher usage/AI allowance hypothesis.

Boundary placeholder. Integration maintenance, provider limits and AI-heavy usage require measurement; no live API is enabled here.

Concrete pilot envelope

Up to 10 restaurants for staged validation; one business, one WhatsApp number and one branch per initial pilot; pickup-first; manual human takeover; no delivery dependency.

Usage measurement baseline

Internal planning sensitivity only: 6 conversational flows × 9 gateway hits = 54 requests per completed order; 90 is the heavy-case sensitivity; 50 completed orders/day/restaurant is a model ceiling, not a capacity claim.

Provider and state boundary

This static mock makes no live payment, delivery or API request. Payment is not custody, order/payment state is not inferred from AI, and staff review remains authoritative for controlled transitions.

Keep this panel closed or remove it before any public release. Do not turn these placeholders into package claims, price claims, service levels or production availability.

Data boundary slot

Public interest is not private setup.

Public mock: no form or contact field is collected. All journey fixtures remain in the browser and clear on refresh.

Controlled setup: menus, WhatsApp identifiers, customer conversations, payment details, staff access and tenant configuration belong in an approved private onboarding path after privacy, retention, deletion, vendor and access controls are decided.

Unknowns remain open: final CTA owner and destinations, legal/privacy notices, retention schedule, domain ownership transfer, trademark clearance, pricing, pilot terms and launch status.
